plan.title: Annual Donations Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for the current fiscal year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y')

panels.title: Donor Count
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS donor_count FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y')

panels.title: Average Donation
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Amount") AS avg_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y')

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Trend
panels.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Payment Mode Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE STRFTIME(STRPTIME("Date", '%d-%m-%Y'), '%Y') = STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
